scope: GPT-2 124M, four existing GGUF checkpoints and the pinned safetensors reference. Q4_K_XL is the previously validated mixed-tensor compatibility fixture, not an Unsloth calibration export.
notes: Each policy uses seven rotated fresh processes per checkpoint and three 64-token trials per process, after 32-token warmup and the identical two-token prompt.
The CPU-only benchmark loads the same production CPUKernels, GPT2 and CPUMatvec implementations. No model or kernel code changed.
PASSIVE is the default native worker policy, chosen to leave CPU time for ANE execution. ACTIVE was selected explicitly with OMP_WAIT_POLICY=ACTIVE.
Both runs held the shared ane.lock and gpu.lock through qwen3.c/tools/benchmark_queue.py; the queue saw no competing benchmark or ANE process at admission.
The desktop was active and resources were not isolated. Large timing variation prevents a controlled CPU-versus-ANE comparison or a worker-policy speedup claim.

During the default-policy run a one-second sample observed substantial browser activity and memory pressure: MemAvailable 883440 kB, SwapTotal 8388576 kB, SwapFree 4358528 kB. Later samples showed about 2.2 GB available. Exact causes of the timing variation are not established.
ANE/hybrid numbers in m1-gguf-dot.json were captured previously, in a separate session. K CPU matrices are decoded to FP16; Q4_0 and Q8_0 retain packed CPU matrices.

All 210 trials passed finite-logit checks in model.step. Every run also compared a fixed-input vocabulary projection to decoded weights: matching argmax and normalized RMSE below 0.5%. This is not full-model parity or a generation-quality evaluation.

"""Measure existing GPT-2 checkpoints using the committed benchmark child."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path('/home/asahi/ane/gpt2')
CACHE = Path.home() / '.cache/orion-gpt2/gguf'
OUTPUT = CACHE / 'native-work/cpu-table-results.json'
CHILD = ROOT / 'tools/benchmark_quantized.py'
saved = json.loads((ROOT / 'provenance/orion-performance/m1-gguf-dot.json').read_text())
cases = [(name, CACHE / ('gpt2-' + name + '.gguf'))
         for name in ('Q4_0', 'Q8_0', 'Q4_K_M', 'Q4_K_XL')]
cases.append(('safetensors', Path(saved['cases']['safetensors/native']['weights'])))
report = dict(
    date_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    backend='cpu', cpu_kernels='native', rounds=7, trials_per_round=3,
    context_case=0, openblas_threads=1,
    timing='model.step on identical saved 64-token traces after 32 warmup steps; excludes checkpoint loading, checks, prompt ingestion, sampling and text output.',
    conditions='Fresh child process per checkpoint per round, rotating checkpoint order; warm weights and OS file caches; four M1 performance-core workers; active desktop. Held ~/ane.lock and ~/gpu.lock through the shared benchmark queue.',
    environment=dict(system=platform.system(), release=platform.release(), machine=platform.machine()),
    benchmark_child='gpt2/tools/benchmark_quantized.py',
    benchmark_child_sha256=hashlib.sha256(CHILD.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    runner_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),
    cases={name: dict(checkpoint=path.name, bytes=path.stat().st_size,
                      sha256=hashlib.file_digest(path.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest(),
                      runs=[]) for name, path in cases},
)
for round_id in range(report['rounds']):
    offset = round_id % len(cases)
    for name, path in cases[offset:] + cases[:offset]:
        command = [sys.executable, str(CHILD), '--weights', str(path),
                   '--cpu-kernels', 'native', '--backend', 'cpu',
                   '--trials', str(report['trials_per_round']), '--context-case', '0']
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(name + ': ' + result.stderr)
        run = json.loads(result.stdout)
        run['round'] = round_id + 1
        report['cases'][name]['runs'].append(run)
        print(f"round {round_id + 1}: {name}: "
              f"{statistics.mean(t['steps_per_second'] for t in run['trials']):.2f} steps/s", flush=True)
        OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
for name, case in report['cases'].items():
    rates = [t['steps_per_second'] for run in case['runs'] for t in run['trials']]
    heads = [statistics.median(run['vocabulary_ms']) for run in case['runs']]
    case['summary'] = dict(median_steps_per_second=statistics.median(rates),
                           min_steps_per_second=min(rates), max_steps_per_second=max(rates),
                           median_vocabulary_ms=statistics.median(heads))
    print(name, json.dumps(case['summary']), flush=True)
OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
